svg.text: Check basic protection before testing alerts
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
On APP01 inspect Defender Antivirus, Windows Firewall and update state. Built-in Antivirus is
not proof of EDR onboarding; if another AV is present, inspect its supported coexistence mode
On AlmaLinux check the existing patch, firewall and SELinux lessons. Keep SELinux enforcing and
permit only the documented lab traffic. Do not assume this distro is supported by Microsoft EDR
merely because Wazuh supports its agent.
Record a recoverable baseline and one specific weakness to fix later. Do not deliberately
expose RDP or install real malware to make a dashboard look busy.
Check: Your baseline records actual protection and patch state, with no blanket security
